This composition looks like an 18Ni maraging steel of the C-300/350 type, with Ni 17.5, Co 11.8, Mo 3.9 and Ti 1.54. The Co and Ti levels are high, which points to a grade like C-350 or a similar high-strength variant. I did not look up the dataset row. This is an estimate from the grade, not the recorded value. Yield strengths for these grades are typically about 2000–2400 MPa, and I'm picking a value near the middle of that range.
